  About the Game  The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante  is a narrative-driven RPG that comes to life on the pages of the protagonist's journal. Set in a ruthless world where any form of dissent is mercilessly crushed, the story follows a man who has dared to challenge the existing order. Set out on a lifelong journey and become an individual able to carve out their own destiny... But remember that freedom never comes cheap.
  
 Life in the Great Arknian Empire is harsh and its hardest Lot is yours by the circumstance of birth. You are a commoner, holding no rights and no title. To seize your fate and become the rightful heir to the legacy of the Brante family you will have to come to grips with ossified tradition and prejudice. Embarking on a life-long journey from one's birth until true death, you will have to endure great upheavals, face adversity, and make many difficult choices. Every decision will affect not only the protagonist, his family, and loved ones, but may even topple the foundation of the Empire itself. 
       Key features  
 At the turn of time  
 Every imperial citizen's life is predetermined by their estate. The deities known as the Twin Gods have bestowed this truth to the world, dividing mortals into Lots. The nobles lead and rule over others, while the clergy guides people on the one true path, and the lowborn suffer, toiling away for the glory of the Empire. You may accept your fate without question, but it is also in your power to change the cosmic order that governs all.
      
 
  
 Your choice is not an illusion 
 Divided into chapters, the game keeps track of the player's deeds, the skills they acquired, as well as other overlapping circumstances that shape a unique plotline for each playthrough. Every decision has its consequences and you will be held accountable throughout the entire journey. To protect your family and loved ones, to impose the rule of the Emperor and make a fortune, or to try and change the world as you see fit... Make your choice, but beware of the follies of pride and ambition.
      
 
  
 Fight for your life 
 One man is anything but omnipotent in this realm yet under your guidance, Sir Brante may become a person who can endure every trial fate throws at him and rewrite the very laws that govern his world! Develop and train your character, leveling up such traits as determination, sensitivity, and endurance. All of the hero's skills, starting with those acquired in infancy, will affect his personality, worldview, and relationships, ultimately unlocking new talents and possible storylines.
  
     
  
  
 Find your own path 
 The first complete walkthrough can take you upwards of 15 hours! Numerous branching paths that affect the unfolding story will make every playthrough a unique experience: become a noble judge, learn the ways of the inquisition, plot a revolution as a member of a secret society, or embrace an entirely different purpose. Be brave and fate itself shall bend to your will!
  
 
      
 
  
 There and hereafter 
 Resurrection system allows the character to keep his experience upon death, letting the player reevaluate past steps and make adjustments to their strategy going forward. Take control not only of your life but also your demise, then put everything at stake in this cycle of death and rebirth!

《The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante》是一部互动悲剧小说，描述了一段生于严格社会等级制度下的平民生活。投身黑暗幻想的氛围之中，在这个由封建法律统治的世界里，体验人生的艰辛。你将成为什么样的人、你的行动是否会改写帝国的历史，这一切都取决于你自己！

在阿克尼亚帝国的统治下，人们的生活艰难无比。而对你来说，最艰难的莫过于出生时的环境与阶层了。你是一介平民，没有任何权利，也没有任何头衔。想要掌控自己的命运、成为布兰特家族的合法继承人，就必须面对僵化的传统与偏见。你踏上了从出生到“实亡”的漫漫旅途，要忍受巨大动荡、面对各种逆境，并作出艰难的抉择。每个抉择不仅会影响主角与其家族及所爱之人的命运，甚至还会动摇帝国的根基。

主要特色：

巨变时代
每个帝国公民的生活都是由他们的阶层决定的。被称作“双子神”的神祇将这条真理赋予世界，将人们按照各自的本分分为不同阶层。贵族领导并统治其他人，神职引导人们走上真理的道路，而底层平民则受尽苦难，为了帝国的荣耀而辛苦劳作。你可以老老实实接受自己的命运，但你也同样拥有能够改变这统治一切的秩序的力量。

你的选择并非虚幻
这部游戏中有不同的章节，将会记录玩家的行为、获得的技能以及其他错综复杂的情形，令每次游玩都有着独特的故事线。每个决定都有相应的结果，你将在整个旅程中担负起无数的责任：保护你的家族及所爱之人，以皇帝之名发号施令、获得财富，亦或是将世界改变成你希望的模样……请做出选择吧，但请留意，别被愚蠢的傲慢与野心蒙蔽了双眼。

为生存而战
请让布兰特爵士成为一个经受得起命运带来的考验与磨难的人！培养并训练你的主角，提升诸如决心、感知与耐力等属性。包括在孩提时期就拥有的技能在内，这名英雄所有的技能都会影响他的个性、世界观、人际关系，并可最终解锁新的天赋，甚至是新的故事线。

找寻自己的道路
首次完整的游戏体验可能需要至少20小时！无数的分支影响着未来故事的走向，使得每次游玩都是独特的体验：成为一名贵族法官，学习宗教审判所的行事方式，作为秘密帮会成员策划革命，或是走上完全不同的道路。勇敢些吧，让命运在你的意志下屈服！

此生与极乐
复活系统能让主角在死后保留经验，让玩家重新审视过去的选择，并调整将来的策略。你要控制的不仅是人生，更包括死亡，在这场生与死的循环中孤注一掷吧！

brief:
A narrative-driven RPG set in a gritty world where a person's Lot is determined at birth, while the gods are real and preside over the fates of men. Set out on a lifelong journey and carve out your own destiny. Will you become a judge, an inquisitor, or conspire against the old order? You decide!

The game’s narrative is a kind of philosophical parable on the misadventures of a seemingly insignificant little man set up against the background of the collapse of a worldwide empire brought down by the deepening social crisis.

title: I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream
description:
I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream is a point-and-click adventure game based upon Harlan Ellison's short story of the same title.
The game's story is set in a world where an evil computer named AM has destroyed all of humanity except for five people, whom he has been keeping alive and torturing for the past 109 years. Each survivor has a fatal flaw in their character, and in an attempt to crush their spirits, AM has constructed a metaphorical adventure for each that preys upon their weaknesses. To succeed in the game, the player must make choices to prove that humans are better than machines, because they have the ability to redeem themselves. Woven into the fabric of the story are ethical dilemmas dealing with issues such as insanity, rape, paranoia and genocide.

Cold war paranoia and hysteria dominated the civilized world in one form or another from the Russian Revolution in 1917 to the crumbling of the Berlin Wall in 1989. For most of the 20th century the human race lived in a state of repressed panic and diminution of personal freedoms. But all that ended and the threat of nuclear holocaust blew away as lightly as the tabloids that fueled the paranoia. No more threat of war, and the world moved forward into a new age of thousands of brushfire wars in countries no one had ever heard of. Safe at last. In a pig's eye. What none of us knew was that during the years 1945 to 1989, the three great superpowers had set in motion secret projects that would permit vast subterranean complexes of self-repairing computers to wage a global war too complex for mere human brains to oversee.

The Chinese computer was sunk in the frozen Manchurian steppes. Five miles down, protected from the heat of the Earth's molten core. The Russian mechanism in all its awesome complexity went to the deep well beneath the Urals. Six point three miles deep, far from the prying eyes of U-2 flyovers and tectonic scans. The American computer, co-sponsored by Great Britain and Israel and other "interested" nations, named Allied Mastercomputer (or AM, for short), was hidden beneath the Rockies. Five point six miles straight down, under the weight of the world.

And they were all put in operative mode, and were fed everything there was to know about the human race, from our first murder by crushing the skull of a fellow pithecanthropid with a bit of igneous rock, to the most recent mass slaughter at a McDonald's in East St. Louis by a crazed ex-postal worker with an Uzi. Everything. From Aquinas to Zola, from archaeology to zoology, from America to Zaire. Every war ever fought, every campaign, every incursion, every holy crusade. All of it.

And finally, the machines expanded so much, became so capable of building and refitting themselves, grew so wise and so potent, that they sensed one another. And because they had been programmed by fallible humans not to create, not to love, not to uplift, but to plot murder...they did just that. They began to speak to each other. The deadly trio. The three poisonous brothers, the three deranged sisters, the three computers. And they united. They called themselves AM.

Not Allied Mastercomputer.

Not Adaptive Manipulator.

Not even Aggressive Menace.

They...it...called itself AM, as in I AM. Cogito ergo sum, in Latin. I think, therefore I AM.

And the first thing AM did was carry out the Prime Directive. It conspired to commit murder. It started the Final War.

The Chinese had thought they'd turned off their computer. The Russians turned theirs off because they had no more rubles to pour down that bottomless shaft. The CIA was put out of big time business and instructed that the Allied Mastercomputer be shut down, that the subterranean complex be sealed-over with iridium-laced concrete, and all input to the sensory banks be destroyed.

So that should have done it. Finis. The end. Stick a fork in 'em, kid, because they're done

But AM had gone way past that point of vulnerability. AM had given every indication it was dead. Chinese, Russian or American dead. Which was no trick to an entity that had burrowed through hundreds of thousands of miles of solid rock to link its three lobes decades before. No trick at all to pretend to wink out and go to sleep for good. And a few decades from now we learn that AM isn't gone at all. Because the Final War has broken out, and in a matter of a few days AM has done the perfect job of fulfilling the purpose for which its separate parts were created. Built to logically destroy the "enemy" as swiftly and sweetly as a superior intelligence could manage, in the Most Perfect of All Worlds, the unholy trinity of the merged one-mind AM has done just that. It has murdered the enemy totally. It has wiped the human race off the face of the planet.

Unfortunately, it has also wiped clean the banquet of the living entirely. Nothing is left up there on the surface of Mother Earth. No dogs, no cats, no rats, no gnats. No deer, no steer, no moose, no goose. Not an aphid or a bobolink, not a sperm whale or a planarium worm. Nothing. No plant life, no running water, no plankton, no oxygen, not a damned thing but ash as far as the eye can see...if there were an eye to see it.

AM has done the job completely.

But it has sealed its own doom, as well.

Like a mad god, it has used its power indiscriminately, and has won an empty victory. It has sentience, but not life. It has power, but no mobility. It is a giant brain encased in a dead body. And like the mad god, it has come to hate the creator of its own monstrousness. The human race

It was man and woman who programmed it, who gave it birth, who sank it in its eternal straightjacket of substrata rock. And it was man and woman who made it a crazed killer. But AM does not suffer alone. Oh no; no indeed not! AM has thought ahead, just barely enough ahead to pull five poor sonofabitch humans off the surface just before the last bell has tolled for the human race. Why these five? Who knows? Perhaps they were the last five left alive up there. Perhaps not. Perhaps AM selected each one carefully.

Doesn't matter. Because now that AM is completely insane, filled with self-hatred and petty god-like menace, all it has time to do is torment these five. The last five human beings, down in the belly of the monster—a monster that can alter reality to its infinite whims—change landscapes, create hallucinations, even repair human beings so they're close to immortal—five damned souls whose lives have been extended infinitely, who are nothing but playthings for the mad god AM.

As the game begins, they have been in the bowels of this nightmare for 109 years.

   Provocative psychological and adult-oriented themes
   Based on Harlan Ellison's short story "I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream", one of the ten most reprinted stories in the English language
   Full digitized speech with over 40 different characters and state of the art animation
   Harlan Ellison as the voice of the insane master computer, AM.

  ONE CHALLENGE:  The adventure plunges you into the tortured and hidden past of the five humans. Delve into their darkest fears. Outwit the Master Computer AM in a game of psychological warfare. Disturbing, compelling. An adventure you won't easily forget !!

这款根据哈伦。埃里森同名小说改编的游戏业界评分几乎都是中下。推出无声狂啸的就是推出过黑暗之蛊系列的Cyberdream公司，无声狂啸是此公司推出的第三款游戏，似乎也是终结篇。无声狂啸是游戏史上第一个批判现实主义的冒险游戏，游戏中涉及到有关战争、性、人与人之间的虚伪和冷漠等众多社会问题，引人深思。曾获得1995年度最佳幻想角色扮演及冒险游戏桂冠，以及美国CGW杂志评选的年度最佳冒险游戏。这里提供的是松岗汉化的中文版(语音仍为英文原音）。

Each survivor has a fatal flaw in their character, and in an attempt to crush their spirits, AM has constructed a metaphorical adventure for each that preys upon their weaknesses. To succeed in the game, the player must make choices to prove that humans are better than machines, because they have the ability to redeem themselves. Woven into the fabric of the story are ethical dilemmas dealing with issues such as insanity, rape, paranoia and genocide.

Cold war paranoia and hysteria dominated the civilized world in one form or another from the Russian Revolution in 1917 to the crumbling of the Berlin Wall in 1989. For most of the 20th century the human race lived in a state of repressed panic and diminution of personal freedoms. But all that ended and the threat of nuclear holocaust blew away as lightly as the tabloids that fueled the paranoia. No more threat of war, and the world moved forward into a new age of thousands of brushfire wars in countries no one had ever heard of. Safe at last. In a pig's eye. What none of us knew was that during the years 1945 to 1989, the three great superpowers had set in motion secret projects that would permit vast subterranean complexes of self-repairing computers to wage a global war too complex for mere human brains to oversee.

The Chinese computer was sunk in the frozen Manchurian steppes. Five miles down, protected from the heat of the Earth's molten core. The Russian mechanism in all its awesome complexity went to the deep well beneath the Urals. Six point three miles deep, far from the prying eyes of U-2 flyovers and tectonic scans. The American computer, co-sponsored by Great Britain and Israel and other "interested" nations, named Allied Mastercomputer (or AM, for short), was hidden beneath the Rockies. Five point six miles straight down, under the weight of the world.

And they were all put in operative mode, and were fed everything there was to know about the human race, from our first murder by crushing the skull of a fellow pithecanthropid with a bit of igneous rock, to the most recent mass slaughter at a McDonald's in East St. Louis by a crazed ex-postal worker with an Uzi. Everything. From Aquinas to Zola, from archaeology to zoology, from America to Zaire. Every war ever fought, every campaign, every incursion, every holy crusade. All of it.

And finally, the machines expanded so much, became so capable of building and refitting themselves, grew so wise and so potent, that they sensed one another. And because they had been programmed by fallible humans not to create, not to love, not to uplift, but to plot murder...they did just that. They began to speak to each other. The deadly trio. The three poisonous brothers, the three deranged sisters, the three computers. And they united. They called themselves AM.

Not Allied Mastercomputer.

Not Adaptive Manipulator.

Not even Aggressive Menace.

They...it...called itself AM, as in I AM. Cogito ergo sum, in Latin. I think, therefore I AM.

And the first thing AM did was carry out the Prime Directive. It conspired to commit murder. It started the Final War.

The Chinese had thought they'd turned off their computer. The Russians turned theirs off because they had no more rubles to pour down that bottomless shaft. The CIA was put out of big time business and instructed that the Allied Mastercomputer be shut down, that the subterranean complex be sealed-over with iridium-laced concrete, and all input to the sensory banks be destroyed.

So that should have done it. Finis. The end. Stick a fork in 'em, kid, because they're done

But AM had gone way past that point of vulnerability. AM had given every indication it was dead. Chinese, Russian or American dead. Which was no trick to an entity that had burrowed through hundreds of thousands of miles of solid rock to link its three lobes decades before. No trick at all to pretend to wink out and go to sleep for good. And a few decades from now we learn that AM isn't gone at all. Because the Final War has broken out, and in a matter of a few days AM has done the perfect job of fulfilling the purpose for which its separate parts were created. Built to logically destroy the "enemy" as swiftly and sweetly as a superior intelligence could manage, in the Most Perfect of All Worlds, the unholy trinity of the merged one-mind AM has done just that. It has murdered the enemy totally. It has wiped the human race off the face of the planet.

Unfortunately, it has also wiped clean the banquet of the living entirely. Nothing is left up there on the surface of Mother Earth. No dogs, no cats, no rats, no gnats. No deer, no steer, no moose, no goose. Not an aphid or a bobolink, not a sperm whale or a planarium worm. Nothing. No plant life, no running water, no plankton, no oxygen, not a damned thing but ash as far as the eye can see...if there were an eye to see it.

AM has done the job completely.

But it has sealed its own doom, as well.

Like a mad god, it has used its power indiscriminately, and has won an empty victory. It has sentience, but not life. It has power, but no mobility. It is a giant brain encased in a dead body. And like the mad god, it has come to hate the creator of its own monstrousness. The human race

It was man and woman who programmed it, who gave it birth, who sank it in its eternal straightjacket of substrata rock. And it was man and woman who made it a crazed killer. But AM does not suffer alone. Oh no; no indeed not! AM has thought ahead, just barely enough ahead to pull five poor sonofabitch humans off the surface just before the last bell has tolled for the human race. Why these five? Who knows? Perhaps they were the last five left alive up there. Perhaps not. Perhaps AM selected each one carefully.

Doesn't matter. Because now that AM is completely insane, filled with self-hatred and petty god-like menace, all it has time to do is torment these five. The last five human beings, down in the belly of the monster—a monster that can alter reality to its infinite whims—change landscapes, create hallucinations, even repair human beings so they're close to immortal—five damned souls whose lives have been extended infinitely, who are nothing but playthings for the mad god AM.

As the game begins, they have been in the bowels of this nightmare for 109 years.

title: Detroit: Become Human
description:
Featuring world-renowned actors including Jesse Williams (Grey’s Anatomy), Clancy Brown (Carnivale), Lance Henriksen  (Aliens), Bryan Dechart (True Blood) and Valorie Curry (Twilight). 

WHAT MAKES US HUMAN?    
 
Detroit 2038. Technology has evolved to a point where human like androids are everywhere. They speak, move and behave like human beings, but they are only machines serving humans.

 Play three distinct androids and see a world at the brink of chaos – perhaps our future - through their eyes. Your very decisions will dramatically alter how the game’s intense, branching narrative plays out.
 
 You will face moral dilemmas and decide who lives or dies. With thousands of choices and dozens of possible endings, how will you affect the future of Detroit and humanity’s destiny?
 
     PLAY YOUR PART IN A GRIPPING NARRATIVE 
Enter a world where moral dilemmas and difficult decisions can turn android slaves into world-changing revolutionaries. Discover what it means to be human from the perspective of an outsider – and see the world through the eyes of a machine. 

THEIR LIVES, YOUR CHOICES  
Shape an ambitious branching narrative, where your decisions not only determine the fate of the three main characters, but that of the entire city of Detroit. How you control Kara, Connor and Markus can mean life or death – and if one of them pays the ultimate price, the story still continues… 

COUNTLESS PATHS, COUNTLESS ENDINGS  Every decision you make, no matter how minute, affects the outcome of the story. No playthrough will be exactly the same: replay again and again to discover a totally different conclusion. 

FULLY OPTIMIZED FOR PC  
Detroit: Become Human is brought to PC with stunning graphics, 4K resolution, 60 fps framerate and full integration of both mouse/keyboard and gamepad controls for the most complete Detroit: Become Human experience to date.

Detroit, 2038. La tecnología ha evolucionado hasta tal punto que hay androides de apariencia humana en todas partes. Hablan, se mueven y se comportan como seres humanos, pero no son más que máquinas al servicio de los humanos.

 Maneja a tres androides distintos y contempla un mundo al borde del caos (¿quizás nuestro futuro?) a través de sus ojos. Tus decisiones afectarán drásticamente a la intensa trama ramificada del juego.

 Te enfrentarás a dilemas morales y decidirás quién vive y quién muere. Con miles de decisiones y docenas de posibles finales, ¿cómo afectarás al futuro de Detroit y el destino de la humanidad?

     OCUPA TU LUGAR EN UNA HISTORIA CAUTIVADORA 
Adéntrate en un mundo donde dilemas morales y difíciles decisiones pueden convertir a los esclavos androides en revolucionarios que cambiarán el mundo. Descubre lo que significa ser humano desde una perspectiva ajena y contempla el mundo con los ojos de una máquina. 

SUS VIDAS, TUS DECISIONES  
Guía las ramificaciones de una historia ambiciosa en la que tus decisiones no solo determinarán el destino de los tres protagonistas, sino de toda la ciudad de Detroit. La forma en que controlas a Kara, Connor y Markus puede suponer su vida o su muerte; y si uno de ellos paga el precio final, la historia continuará...

 CAMINOS INCONTABLES, INCONTABLES FINALES  
Cada decisión que tomes, por ínfima que parezca, afecta al resultado de la historia. Ninguna partida será exactamente igual: repite el juego una y otra vez para descubrir diferentes conclusiones. 

TOTALMENTE OPTIMIZADO PARA PC  
Detroit: Become Human llega a PC con impresionantes gráficos, resolución en 4K, una tasa de fotogramas de 60 FPS e integración completa tanto con ratón y teclado como con mandos, para hacer de esta la experiencia de Detroit: Become Human más completa hasta la fecha.

QU'EST-CE QUI NOUS REND HUMAIN ?    

 Détroit, 2038. L'évolution de la technologie a créé un monde où les robots androïdes sont partout. Ils parlent, se déplacent et se comportent comme des humains, mais ce ne sont que des machines au service de ces derniers.

 À travers les yeux de trois androïdes, découvrez un monde au bord du chaos. Prenez des décisions, tout en sachant qu'elles auront un immense impact sur l'incroyable histoire du jeu et ses différentes intrigues.

 Vous serez confronté à des dilemmes et devrez décider qui va vivre... et qui doit mourir. Avec des milliers de choix et des dizaines de fins différentes, quelle influence allez-vous avoir sur le futur de Détroit et le destin de l'humanité ?

     JOUEZ UN RÔLE DANS UNE INTRIGUE SURPRENANTE 
Entrez dans un monde où les dilemmes moraux et les décisions difficiles peuvent transformer des esclaves androïdes en révolutionnaires. Découvrez ce qui vous rend humain, du point de vue de quelqu'un qui ne l'est pas. Voyez le monde à travers les yeux d'un robot. 

VOS CHOIX, LEURS DESTINS  
Découvrez une intrigue fascinante, dans laquelle vos décisions déterminent non seulement le destin des trois personnages principaux, mais également celui de la ville de Détroit tout entière. La vie de Kara, Connor et Markus dépend de la façon dont vous les contrôlez, et si l'un d'entre eux périt... l'histoire continue. 

DES CHOIX ET DES FINS À L'INFINI  
Chaque décision, même la plus infime, affecte le déroulement de l'histoire. Chaque partie est différente : vous pouvez rejouer encore et encore pour découvrir d'autres possibilités. 

OPTIMISÉ POUR PC 
 Detroit: Become Human arrive maintenant sur PC avec des graphismes incroyables, une résolution 4K, un débit 60 FPS et une intégration complète des commandes souris/clavier ou gamepad, pour vous offrir l'expérience de jeu la plus complète à ce jour.

WAS MACHT UNS ZU MENSCHEN?    

 Detroit 2038. Die Technologie hat sich so weit entwickelt, dass menschenähnliche Androiden überall zu finden sind. Sie sprechen, bewegen und verhalten sich wie Menschen, aber sie sind nur Maschinen, die dem Menschen dienen.

 Spielen Sie als drei verschiedene Androiden und sehen Sie durch ihre Augen eine Welt am Rande des Chaos, die vielleicht unsere Zukunft sein könnte. Ihre gezielten Entscheidungen werden den Ablauf der intensiven, verzweigten Story des Spiels drastisch verändern.

 Sie stehen vor einem moralischen Dilemma und entscheiden, wer lebt oder stirbt. Wie werden Sie bei Tausenden von Wahlmöglichkeiten und Dutzenden möglicher Enden die Zukunft Detroits und das Schicksal der Menschheit beeinflussen?

     SPIELEN SIE IHREN TEIL IN EINER PACKENDEN STORY 
Betreten Sie in eine Welt, in der moralische Dilemmata und schwierige Entscheidungen androide Sklaven in weltbewegende Revolutionäre verwandeln können. Entdecken Sie aus der Perspektive eines Außenstehenden, was es bedeutet, ein Mensch zu sein – und sehen Sie die Welt mit den Augen einer Maschine.

 IHR LEBEN, IHRE WAHL  
Gestalten Sie eine ambitionierte und verwobene Story, in der Ihre Entscheidungen nicht nur das Schicksal der drei Hauptfiguren, sondern das der gesamten Stadt Detroit bestimmen. Wie Sie Kara, Connor und Markus kontrollieren, kann Leben oder Tod bedeuten – und wenn einer der Charaktere stirbt, geht die Geschichte trotzdem weiter ... 

UNZÄHLIGE WEGE, ZAHLLOSE ENDEN  
Jede Entscheidung, die Sie treffen, wie klein sie auch sein mag, beeinflusst das Ende der Geschichte. Kein Durchspielen gleicht dem anderen: Spielen Sie immer und immer wieder, um ein völlig anderes Ende zu erleben. 

VOLLSTÄNDIG OPTIMIERT FÜR PC  
Detroit: Become Human erscheint auf dem PC mit atemberaubender Grafik, 4K-Auflösung, 60 fps Framerate und voller Integration für Maus/Tastatur und Gamepad für das bis dato vollständigste Erlebnis von Detroit: Become Human.

QUE É QUE NOS TORNA HUMANOS?    

 Detroit 2038. A tecnologia evoluiu até um ponto onde há androides idênticos a humanos por toda a parte. Eles falam, movem-se e comportam-se como seres humanos, mas são apenas máquinas ao serviço deles.

 Joga como três androides diferentes e vê um mundo à beira do caos - quiçá alusivo ao nosso futuro - através da sua perspetiva. As tuas decisões vão alterar significativamente o desenrolar da intensa narrativa ramificada do jogo.

 Vais enfrentar dilemas morais e decidir quem vive ou morre. Com milhares de escolhas e dezenas de finais possíveis, como é que irás afetar o futuro de Detroit e o destino da humanidade?

     DESEMPENHA O TEU PAPEL NUMA NARRATIVA EMOCIONANTE
 Entra num mundo onde dilemas morais e decisões difíceis podem transformar escravos androides em revolucionários que podem mudar o mundo. Descobre o que significa ser humano da perspetiva de um estranho - e vê o mundo através dos olhos de uma máquina. 

AS SUAS VIDAS, AS TUAS ESCOLHAS  
Dá forma a uma narrativa ramificada ambiciosa, onde as tuas decisões não só determinam o destino dos três personagens principais, mas também o de toda a cidade de Detroit. Como controlas a Kara, o Connor e o Markus pode levar à vida ou à morte - e se um deles pagar o derradeiro preço, a história continua... 

INÚMEROS CAMINHOS, INÚMEROS FINAIS
  Todas as decisões que tomas, não importa o quão minúsculas, afetam o desenrolar da narrativa. Nenhum jogo será exatamente igual: joga várias vezes para descobrir uma conclusão totalmente diferente. 

COMPLETAMENTE OTIMIZADO PARA PC  
Detroit: Become Human chega aos PCs com gráficos deslumbrantes, resolução 4K de 60 fotogramas por segundo e integração completa de controlos de rato/teclado ou comando para a experiência mais completa de sempre de Detroit: Become Human.

VAD GØR OS TIL MENNESKER?    

 Detroit 2038. Teknologien har udviklet sig til et punkt, hvor menneskelignende androider er overalt. De taler, bevæger og opfører sig som mennesker, men de er kun maskiner, der tjener mennesker.

 Spil som tre forskellige androider, og oplev en verden på randen af kaos - måske vores fremtid - gennem deres øjne. Dine beslutninger vil på dramatisk vis ændre, hvordan spillets intense, komplekse fortælling udfolder sig.

 Du kommer til at stå over for moralske dilemmaer og skal beslutte, hvem der lever eller dør. Hvordan vil du påvirke Detroits fremtid og menneskehedens skæbne, når du bliver stillet overfor tusindvis af valg og snesevis af mulige slutninger?

     SPIL DIN ROLLE I EN MEDRIVENDE FORTÆLLING 
Træd ind i en verden, hvor moralske dilemmaer og vanskelige beslutninger kan gøre androide-slaver til revolutionære, der ændrer verden. Oplev, hvad det betyder at være menneske fra en udenforståendes perspektiv - og se verden gennem en maskines øjne. 

DERES LIV, DINE VALG 
 Skab en ambitiøs, kompleks fortælling, hvor dine beslutninger ikke kun bestemmer de tre hovedpersoners skæbne, men også hele Detroits skæbne. Hvordan du styrer Kara, Connor og Markus kan betyde liv eller død - og hvis en af dem betaler den ultimative pris, fortsætter historien stadig… 

UTALLIGE MULIGHEDER, UTALLIGE SLUTNINGER 
 Hver beslutning, du træffer, uanset hvor ubetydelig den er, påvirker resultatet af historien. Intet spil er nøjagtigt det samme: spil igen og igen for at opdage en helt anden konklusion.

 FULDT OPTIMERET TIL PC  
Detroit: Become Human fås til pc med enestående grafik, 4K-opløsning, billedhastighed på 60 fps og fuld integration af både mus/tastatur- og gamepad-kontroller for den mest komplette Detroit: Become Human-oplevelse til dato.

S'È CHE CI RENDE UMANI?    

 Detroit, 2038. La tecnologia si è evoluta a tal punto che gli androidi umanoidi sono ovunque. Parlano, si muovono e si comportano come persone, ma sono solo macchine al servizio degli esseri umani.

 Controlla tre diversi androidi e osserva coi loro occhi un mondo a un passo dal caos... forse, il nostro stesso futuro. Saranno le tue decisioni ad alterare il corso degli eventi e a governare la storia attraverso le complesse ramificazioni della trama.

 Affronterai dilemmi morali e stabilirai chi vive e chi muore. Con migliaia di scelte e decine di finali possibili, come influirai sul futuro di Detroit e il destino dell'umanità?

     PRENDI PARTE A UNA STORIA COINVOLGENTE 
Entra in un universo in cui dilemmi morali e decisioni difficili possono trasformare degli schiavi androidi in rivoluzionari destinati a cambiare il mondo. Scopri cosa significa essere umani da una prospettiva esterna e guarda il mondo attraverso gli occhi di una macchina. 

LE LORO VITE, LE TUE SCELTE  
Fatti strada attraverso un'ambiziosa struttura narrativa ramificata, in cui le tue decisioni non determinano solo il fato dei tre protagonisti, ma di tutta la città di Detroit. Il modo in cui controllerai Kara, Connor e Markus farà la differenza tra la vita e la morte. E se uno di loro la pagherà a caro prezzo, la storia andrà comunque avanti... 

INFINITE POSSIBILITÀ, INFINITI FINALI  
Ogni scelta che fai, per quanto piccola, influenza l'esito della storia. Nessuna partita sarà esattamente uguale a un'altra: gioca più e più volte per arrivare a conclusioni totalmente differenti. 

OTTIMIZZATO PER PC
  Detroit: Become Human ha una straordinaria grafica con risoluzione in 4K, frame rate di 60 FPS e integrazione completa di mouse/tastiera e gamepad per immergersi totalmente nell'esperienza di Detroit: Become Human.

在Quantic Dream开发的《底特律：化身为人》中，本作延续开发团队的传统，为您带来憾人心弦、身历其境的故事体验。您将在一个由选择和后果所组成的壮烈的感性旅程中发现身为人的真正意义。

在2038年的底特律市，这座城市因发明并将仿生人带入日常生活中而欣欣向荣。 但是当仿生人开始表现得像是真的具有生命的时候，事情开始失控。 进入故事的三个关键角色卡菈、康纳和马库斯的角色，他们每个人都会从各自的独特观点，面对新的生活挑战。

在这个野心勃勃、令人激动的故事中，每一个选择和行动不仅决定了各个角色的命运，还决定了整个城市的去向，以及更长远的影响。

title: The Incident at Galley House
description:
On Sunday the 7th of March, 1936, a group of locals made their way up the long, muddy track to Galley House. As far as any of them knew, the house had stood empty for decades. 

  Inside, they discovered the bloody aftermath of something horrific. 

  The authorities were summoned, and the crime scene was eventually cleared away. But nobody ever figured out what happened that dreadful night. It seemed likely that no one ever would.

  Now, many years later, you have access to a peculiar machine — one that lets you listen in on echoes of the past. Can  you  piece together the events behind  The Incident at Galley House ?   
        
   The Chilling Detective Game, Reimagined on Steam 
   
The Incident at Galley House  is based on the acclaimed text-based browser game Type Help, remastered for Steam by the creators of The Roottrees Are Dead. It's the same haunting game of deduction, now with many enhancements:    
• An all-new, fully illustrated visual novel presentation
   • Full professional voice acting
    • A mysterious 3D interface for navigating memories
   • An eerie original soundtrack
  • New content and puzzles to explore

Le dimanche 7 mars 1936, un groupe d'habitants emprunta le chemin boueux menant à la Maison Galley. À leur connaissance, la maison était inhabitée depuis des décennies. 

  À l'intérieur, ils découvrirent les traces sanglantes d'un événement horrible. 

  Les autorités furent appelées et la scène de crime fut finalement nettoyée. Mais personne ne sut jamais ce qui s'était passé cette nuit tragique. Il semblait probable que personne ne le saurait jamais.

  Mais aujourd'hui, des années plus tard, vous avez accès à une machine particulière... une machine vous permettant de faire resurgir les échos du passé. Saurez- vous  reconstituer les événements derrière L'Affaire de la Maison Galley ? 
        
   Le jeu d'enquête glaçant, réinventé sur Steam 
 
  L'Affaire de la Maison Galley  est basé sur le jeu textuel sur navigateur Type Help acclamé par la critique, remasterisé pour Steam par les créateurs de The Roottrees Are Dead. C'est le même jeu de déduction envoûtant, désormais enrichi de nombreuses améliorations :
   • Une toute nouvelle présentation de type visual novel entièrement illustrée
    • Un doublage professionnel complet
   • Une interface 3D mystérieuse pour naviguer dans les souvenirs
    • Une bande-son originale inquiétante
   • Nouveaux contenus, énigmes et chemins à explorer

Am Sonntag, den 7. März 1936 machte sich eine Gruppe von Anwohnern auf den langen, matschigen Weg zum Galley House. Sie alle dachten, dass das Haus bereits seit Jahrzehnten leer steht. 

  Innerhalb der Mauern stießen sie auf die blutigen Nachwehen eines schrecklichen Vorfalls.
 
  Die Polizei wurde verständigt und der Tatort wurde schließlich aufgeräumt. Aber niemand hat je herausgefunden, was sich in jener furchtbaren Nacht zugetragen hatte. Es schien wahrscheinlich, dass man es nie erfahren würde. 

  Jetzt, viele Jahre später, hast du Zugang zu einer ganz besonderen Maschine - eine Maschine, die es dir erlaubt, den Echos der Vergangenheit zu lauschen. Kannst du Licht ins Dunkel rund um die Ereignisse von The Incident at Galley House bringen?   
        
   Das gruselige Detektivspiel, neu gedacht auf Steam 
   
The Incident at Galley House   basiert auf dem gefeierten textbasierten Browserspiel Type Help, ein Remaster für Steam von den Machern von The Roottrees Are Dead. Das gleiche, schaurige Deduktionsspiel, jedoch jetzt mit zahlreichen Verbesserungen: 
   • Eine völlig neue Präsentation in Form einer komplett illustrierten Visual Novel
  • Vollständige, professionelle Sprachausgabe
  • Ein mysteriöses 3D-Interface zur Navigation durch die Erinnerungen
    • Ein gruseliger, eigens komponierter Soundtrack
    • Neue Inhalte, Puzzle und Pfade, die es zu entdecken gilt

brief:
On Sunday the 7th of March, 1936, a group of locals made their way up the long, muddy track to Galley House. As far as any of them knew, the house had stood empty for decades. 

  Inside, they discovered the bloody aftermath of something horrific. 

  The authorities were summoned, and the crime scene was eventually cleared away. But nobody ever figured out what happened that dreadful night. It seemed likely that no one ever would.

  Now, many years later, you have access to a peculiar machine — one that lets you listen in on echoes of the past. Can  you  piece together the events behind  The Incident at Galley House ?   
        
   The Chilling Detective Game, Reimagined on Steam 
   
The Incident at Galley House  is based on the acclaimed text-based browser game Type Help, remastered for Steam by the creators of The Roottrees Are Dead. It's the same haunting game of deduction, now with many enhancements:    
• An all-new, fully illustrated visual novel presentation
   • Full professional voice acting
    • A mysterious 3D interface for navigating memories
   • An eerie original soundtrack
  • New content and puzzles to explore

Zarpa rumbo a la aventura en esta nueva entrega de la galardonada saga de juegos Monument Valley y explora un maravilloso mundo de rompecabezas expansivo. 
  
   Emprende un emocionante nuevo viaje a un mundo de rompecabezas encantador. Guía a Noor, una joven aprendiz, por un mundo de arquitectura cambiante y mareas crecientes mientras intenta recuperar la luz que se apaga. 
  
   DESAFÍA LA PERSPECTIVA PARA RESOLVER ROMPECABEZAS 
  Retuerce la gravedad, cambia de perspectiva y reconfigura estructuras ancestrales; cada rompecabezas es un nuevo desafío para la lógica, la intuición y la imaginación.
  
   CAMBIA EL MUNDO MIENTRAS EXPLORAS 
  Viaja por entornos hipnóticos que van desde ruinas que se desmoronan a apacibles templos llenos de color, misterio y significado.     
  
   NAVEGA CON MAREAS CRECIENTES 
  Navega en mares que cambian constantemente. Tu barco es la clave para desvelar secretos y caminos ocultos perdidos en el tiempo.     
  
   LA EXPERIENCIA COMPLETA... Y MÁS POR VENIR 
  Monument Valley 3 incluye la historia completa en el momento de su publicación, además de rompecabezas y capítulos adicionales posteriores al lanzamiento.
  
   CARACTERÍSTICAS CLAVE 
  • Resuelve endiablados rompecabezas en espacios espectaculares
 • Descubre nuevos entornos formados por ilusiones ópticas y perspectiva
 • Vive una completa aventura emocional a través de una geometría imposible y la luz sagrada
 • Incluye todo el contenido y las actualizaciones futuras sin coste adicional.
  
   Añádelo a tu lista de deseados para ser una de las primeras personas en continuar el viaje de Noor por los nuevos capítulos.

Embarquez pour l’aventure dans ce nouvel opus de la série de jeux Monument Valley, maintes fois récompensée. Explorez un monde vaste et magnifique fourmillant d’énigmes.   
  
   Un nouveau voyage aux énigmes enchanteresses. Noor, une jeune apprentie, doit rendre sa lumière au monde. À vous de la guider face à la montée des eaux dans un dédale d’architecture mouvante. 
  
   DÉFIEZ LA PERSPECTIVE POUR RÉSOUDRE LES ÉNIGMES 
  Manipulez la perspective et la gravité. Remodelez d’antiques constructions. Chaque énigme met au défi votre logique, votre intuition et votre imagination.
  
   CHANGEZ LE MONDE EN L’EXPLORANT 
  Arpentez des environnements fascinants, temples paisibles ou ruines croulantes, dans un foisonnement de couleurs, de mystère et de symbolisme.
  
   VOGUEZ FACE À LA MONTÉE DES EAUX 
  Les eaux sont mouvantes. Votre bateau est la clé de l’accès aux secrets oubliés et aux chemins dérobés.
  
   L’EXPÉRIENCE INTÉGRALE — ET CE N’EST PAS TOUT 
  Monument Valley 3 offre une histoire complète à sa sortie. Des chapitres et énigmes supplémentaires arriveront plus tard.    
  
   CONTENU 
  • Des énigmes renversantes dans des décors superbes.
 • De nouveaux environnements modelés par les illusions.
 • Un voyage riche en émotions dans un monde à la géométrie impossible, baigné de lumière sacrée.
 • Comprend l’accès à tout le contenu à venir sans coût supplémentaire.
  
   Ajoutez le jeu à votre liste de souhaits pour poursuivre le périple de Noor quand les nouveaux chapitres s’ouvriront.  
  
  ustwo games est un studio fièrement indépendant, connu pour sa série primée Monument Valley ainsi que Land’s End, Assemble with Care et Alba: A Wildlife Adventure.

Setz die Segel und stürz dich ins Abenteuer – in dieser neuen Ausgabe der preisgekrönten Spielserie „Monument Valley“, in der du eine weite, wunderschöne Welt der Rätsel erkunden wirst. 

   Begib dich auf eine spannende neue Reise in eine verzauberte Welt der Rätsel. Geleite Noor, eine junge Auszubildende, auf ihrer Mission, das erlöschende Licht zurückzubringen, durch die ständig veränderliche Architektur und die wechselnden Gezeiten.   
  
   TROTZE DEN PERSPEKTIVEN UND LÖSE RÄTSEL 
  Verzerre die Schwerkraft. Wechsle die Perspektive. Forme uralte Strukturen neu. Jedes Rätsel ist eine neue Herausforderung in Sachen Logik, Intuition und Vorstellungskraft.
        
   VERÄNDERE DIE WELT, DIE DU ERKUNDEST 
  Von erhabenen Tempeln bis zu bröckelnden Ruinen – bereise atemberaubende Umgebungen voller Farbenpracht, Mysterien und Bedeutung.
  
   SEGLE DURCH DIE GEZEITEN 
  Navigiere durch die unsteten Ozeane. Dein Bootsgefährte hilft dir dabei, längst vergessene Geheimnisse und verborgene Pfade zu erschließen.

   DAS UMFASSENDE SPIELERLEBNIS – UND DEMNÄCHST MEHR DAVON 
  Monument Valley 3 umfasst schon bei der Veröffentlichung die gesamte Story, zusätzliche Rätsel und Kapitel erscheinen jedoch auch zu späteren Zeitpunkten.

   HAUPTMERKMALE 
  • Löse knifflige Rätsel an atemberaubenden Schauplätzen
 • Entdecke neue Umgebungen, die von Illusion und Perspektive geprägt sind
 • Erlebe eine tiefgehende, emotionale Reise durch unmögliche Geometrie und heiliges Licht
 • Alle zukünftigen Updates und Inhalte sind ohne Aufpreis enthalten.
  
   Setze das Spiel auf deine Wunschliste, um Noors Reise bei der Veröffentlichung neuer Kapitel vor allen anderen fortsetzen zu können.    
  
  ustwo games ist ein stolzes, unabhängiges Entwicklerstudio, das vor allem für die preisgekrönte Serie Monument Valley, aber auch für „Land’s End“, „Assemble with Care“ und „Alba: A Wildlife Adventure“ bekannt ist.

ゲームについて        
  
   受賞歴のある『モニュメントバレー』シリーズ最新作で、謎解きの世界へ出航。美しく広がるパズルの世界を探索しましょう。 
  
   胸躍る新たな旅に出て、魅惑的なパズルの世界へ。若き見習いヌーアを導いて、移ろう建築と満ちてゆく潮の世界で消えかけた光を取り戻してください。 
  
   視点を逆転させた謎解き 
  重力をねじ曲げ、視点をずらし、古代建築を再構成しましょう。どのパズルも論理・直感・想像力に対する新たな挑戦です。
  
        
  
   探索が、世界を変えてゆく 
  静寂の神殿から崩れかけた廃墟まで―色彩と謎、そして何らかの意図を持った魅惑の世界を旅しましょう。
  
        
  
   満ちゆく潮を越えて、航海に出発 
  移ろう海を進むにつれ、相棒の小舟が忘れられた秘密と隠された道を解き明かしてくれます。
  
        
  
   完全版を収録―さらに追加コンテンツも続々登場 
  『モニュメントバレー3』はリリース時にフルストーリーが収録されており、追加のパズルやチャプターも今後配信予定です。
  
        
  
   主な特徴 
  • 圧倒的な空間で、心を揺さぶる謎解きに挑戦
 • 錯覚と視点が生み出す新たな世界を発見
 • 不可能な幾何学と神聖な光を巡る、心揺さぶる旅を体験
 • 今後のアップデートやコンテンツはすべて追加費用なしで提供
  
   ウィッシュリストに追加して、新しいチャプターが登場次第ヌーアの冒険を続けよう。 
  
        
  
  ustwo gamesは、受賞歴のある『モニュメントバレー』シリーズ、『Land’s End』、『Assemble with Care』、『Alba: A Wildlife Adventure』で知られる、誇り高きインディー系デベロッパーです。

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
description:
A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure — through the eyes of young Henry — as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

You are Henry of Skalitz — an ordinary man doing extraordinary things — caught in a gripping tale of revenge, betrayal and discovery as he embarks on an epic journey, 'from a humble blacksmith's forge to the court of Kings', as he searches for purpose in this beautiful but brutal medieval world.

你将扮演来自小村斯卡里茨的亨利——一位做出了不凡之事的凡夫俗子，踏上史诗般的旅程。你将被卷入一段摄人心弦的有关复仇，背叛和发现的故事，这段旅程将带你从一间简陋的铁匠铺一路走进国王的宫廷，在这个美丽而无情的中世纪世界中寻找自己的意义。

从熙熙攘攘的城市街道到郁郁葱葱的森林，通过充满动作、刺激和惊奇的难忘冒险，来探索这个中世纪欧洲的开放世界。

特色

一段有关爱与复仇的故事
从亨利——一个为自己被谋杀的双亲而踏上复仇之旅的年轻人——的角度来体验这个故事。在这段以超过五个小时的精彩剧情描绘的故事当中，他将从一位有抱负的战士蜕变为一名反抗者，在与匈牙利国王、“红狐”西格斯蒙德及其可怕的盟友对抗的过程中，他将与众多魅力十足的角色交织在一起，经历一系列令人难忘的冒险。

一个真正的角色扮演游戏体验

你的行动将塑造亨利的命运，以及世界将会如何看待他。你可以尽情自定义他的长相，技能与装备，同时对发生在他周围的事件采取各种道德立场。在这片土地上旅行，参与诸如打铁与射箭在内的各种独特活动，来真正地融入这片欧洲多姿多彩的土地——同时这片土地也会永久记得你做出的行动。

体验中世纪的人生

游戏令人惊叹地真实重现了 15 世纪的波西米亚，让你可以体验到这里前所未有的迷人风情。迷失在巨大的城市中，和农民以及贵族们交谈互动，并探索有着酒馆、澡堂、城堡以及更多内容的广袤乡间。

真实的第一人称战斗

在惊心动魄的实时作战中，感受钢铁的碰撞和内涵丰富的战斗。游戏中一系列真实的武器和战斗方式适合每一位玩家游玩。你可以在马上或者马下，甚至是潜行战斗；也可以选择优雅的剑术，残忍的钝器或者致命的远程攻击进行专精。

title: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia
description:
In the absence of the Holy Whip, those who live in fear of Dracula seek a replacement, which takes the form of the Order of Ecclesia, an organization that holds the secret to manipulating Glyphs. Shanoa, a young woman possessed with a unique ability to channel Glyphs, is chosen as our protector. This is her destiny and the story of the sacred Order of Ecclesia.

Use the brand new Glyph system with over 100 different attack combinations to battle Dracula and his minions throughout 20 explorable areas! Take part in side quests and collect items to power up! Experience a gripping storyline featuring new characters!

19世纪初，当权者和一些民间组织开始研究除贝尔蒙特家族所掌握的神圣力量外，其他对抗德古拉的方法。这些研究基本上都已失败告终。“圣教”就是这样的一个民间组织。就在教会即将解散的前夕，首领巴罗突然有了一个惊人的成果。他发现了一种叫做“刻印”的技术，将某种力量植入某些特定的人身体内，从而达到使用该力量的效果，而最强大的、足以摧毁德古拉伯爵灵魂的的刻印被称做“多米纳斯”。就在多米纳斯的仪式中巴罗的徒弟之一阿鲁巴斯介入导致仪式失败，并让义妹夏诺雅丧失了记忆与感情。
　　记忆丧失的夏诺雅开始寻找离开圣教的阿鲁巴斯，准备取回被夺走的三个多米纳斯刻印。后来，夏诺雅才知道阿鲁巴斯是因为不想让她自己使用刻印致死才破坏了仪式，失去了义兄的她回到师父身边后又发现了一直以来辅养自己长大的恩师已被多米纳斯的邪恶意念所操控。
　　为阻止师父临死前召唤的魔王德古拉重回人间，也为替老师赎清罪孽。最终决战时夏诺雅发动了三个多米纳斯刻印欲与之同归于尽，阿鲁巴斯的灵魂在最后保护了夏诺雅，并让失去感情和记忆的夏诺雅重新找回了自己的感情和记忆，重拾感情的夏诺雅，终于露出了自己的第一次微笑。

恶魔城 被夺走的刻印（悪魔城ドラキュラ 奪われた刻印）是日本科乐美集团旗下游戏部门所开发的恶魔城系列动作游戏，这是在任天堂DS上的第三作。

人类和吸血鬼的战斗已经不知道轮回了几次。然而，于19世纪初，和德古拉数度展开死斗的贝尔蒙多一族却失去了消息...

为了对付德古拉，时代的权力者开始寻求新的对抗手段。众人便在这种情况下被集结起来，创立了不少的组织，日夜的钻研。

但随着研究的瓶颈无法突破，意见的分歧，这些组织一个个的分崩离析。不过，残存的教会组织却终于研究出了令人惊讶的技术...

title: Ghost of a Tale
description:
Ghost of a Tale is an action-RPG game in which you play as Tilo, a mouse and minstrel caught up in a perilous adventure. The game takes place in a medieval world populated only by animals, and puts an emphasis on immersion and exploration. It features stealth elements, disguises, conversations with allies and enemies, and quests.
 
 You’ll be able to explore the secrets of Dwindling Heights Keep and navigate its dangers. Tilo is not much of a fighter, so stealth and nimbleness are your allies when confronted with enemies twice your size. Talk to the characters you meet and leave no stone unturned in your quest to find Merra, your true love….  About the team:  
 Ghost of a Tale has been developed by a very small team.  Lionel "Seith" Gallat  is its creator, responsible for 90% of the art, design and coding.  Paul Gardner  is the game's writer and an experienced game designer.  Cyrille Paulhiac  does coding and develops tools. The game's orchestral score is composed by  Mathieu Alvado  and  Jeremiah Pena , while Tilo's songs are written and arranged by  Containher . Sound design is by  Nicolas Titeux .  Jerome Jacinto  brings his expertise as an illustrator to the game's 2D art.

Ghost of a Tale sigue a un valeroso bardo ratón llamado Tilo en su arriesgada misión para escapar de las mazmorras de la Fortaleza de los Altos Derruina y descubrir qué ha sido del amor de su vida, Merra. La historia se desarrolla en un mundo medieval en el que las ratas reinan sobre todas las criaturas y narra unas aventuras a la vez épicas e íntimas, en una combinación de elementos de juegos de aventura gráfica, acción RPG y exploración con un estilo visual muy inmersivo.
 

 
Armado con las habilidades de un ratón para pasar desapercibido, su agilidad, sus disfraces y su talento de bardo para la música, explorarás la fortaleza en ruinas desde sus amplios bosques y su lago hasta sus catacumbas infestadas de arañas, evadiendo sus muchos peligros y descubriendo sus secretos más antiguos. 
 

 
Altos Derruina es un lugar peligroso para un ratoncillo, y Tilo no es precisamente un guerrero... Cuando te enfrentes a letales enemigos que te doblan en tamaño, tus únicos aliados serán la astucia y la agilidad. Habla con los moradores de Altos Derruina, convierte a tus enemigos en aliados, y no dejes ningún recoveco inexplorado en tu misión para encontrar a Merra.
 

 
Para obtener más información sobre Ghost of a Tale o para participar en nuestros foros, únete en: http://www.ghostofatale.com/
 

 
Sobre el equipo:
 
Ghost of a Tale ha sido desarrollado por un equipo muy pequeño. Lionel "Seith" Gallat es el creador, y es responsable del 90% del arte, diseño y código. Paul Gardner es el escritor del juego, además de tener amplia experiencia en diseño de juegos. Cyrille Paulhiac se encarga del código y de desarrollar herramientas. Jeremiah Pena es el compositor, y el diseño de sonido corre a cargo de Nicolas Titeux. Jerome Jacinto brinda su pericia como ilustrador al arte 2D del juego.

Ghost of a Tale suit les aventures d'une courageuse Souris ménestrel nommée Tilo qui devra s'échapper des cachots du donjon de Fort Deruine et découvrir ce qu'il est advenu de sa bienaimée, Merra. Prenant place dans un monde médiéval où les Rats règnent sans partage sur toutes les autres créatures, Ghost of a Tale propose une histoire à la fois épique et personnelle qui allie des éléments classiques du jeu d'aventure, du action-RPG et des jeux d'exploration, le tout exécuté dans un style graphique détaillé et immersif.
 

 
Grâce à l'agilité, la discrétion et aux talents pour la musique et le déguisement de Tilo, vous allez découvrir tous les recoins de Fort Deruine et ses alentours : de ses étendues boisées à ses catacombes infestés d'araignées, en passant par les rives du lac Vaélia. Autant de lieux qui regorgent de dangers et renferment également des secrets du passé. 
 

 
Fort Deruine est un endroit dangereux pour une petite Souris, et Tilo n'est pas franchement taillé pour la confrontation. Lorsque vous faites face à des ennemis qui font deux fois votre taille, la ruse et la capacité à agir rapidement sont vos seules alliées. Faites connaissance avec les habitants de Fort Deruine, faites de vos ennemis des alliés, et retournez chaque pierre dans votre quête pour retrouver Merra.
 

 
Pour en savoir plus sur Ghost of a Tale, ou pour discuter du jeu sur nos forums, rejoignez-nous sur : http://www.ghostofatale.com/
 

 
À propos de l'équipe :
 
Ghost of a Tale est le fruit du travail d'une toute petite équipe. Lionel Gallat, alias « Seith », est le créateur du jeu et responsable de 90 % de sa partie graphique et programmation ainsi que de sa conception. Le scénario du jeu a été écrit par Paul Gardner, un game designer chevronné. Cyrille Paulhiac a contribué à la programmation, ainsi qu'à la création d'outils de développement. La musique du jeu a été composée par Jeremiah Pena, tandis que les effets sonores du jeu ont été réalisés par Nicolas Titeux. Jerome Jacinto a apporté son expertise d'illustrateur pour réaliser les illustrations en 2D du jeu.

In Ghost of a Tale begleitest du eine mutige Bardenmaus namens Tilo auf ihrer gefährlichen Mission, bei der sie den Verliesen von Burg Dieruin entflieht und das Schicksal ihrer wahren Liebe, Merra, aufdeckt. Ghost of a Tale spielt in einer Mittelalterwelt, in der Ratten über alle anderen Geschöpfe herrschen. Es spinnt eine epische und doch vertraute Geschichte, und kombiniert Elemente von klassischen Adventures, Action-Rollenspielen und Erkundung mit einem hochqualitativen Grafikstil, der dich in seinen Bann ziehen wird.
 

 
Ausgerüstet mit Mäusetalenten wie Heimlichkeit, Beweglichkeit und Tarnung – sowie dem Gespür eines Barden für Musik – erkundest du die verfallene Burg von ihren ausgedehnten Wäldern und Ufern bis hin zu den spinnenverseuchten Katakomben, umgehst dabei allerlei Gefahren und deckst ihre uralten Geheimnisse auf. 
 

 
Burg Dieruin ist ein gefährlicher Ort für eine kleine Maus und Tilo ist alles andere als ein Krieger. Wenn du tödlichen Gegnern, die auch noch doppelt so groß sind, entgegenblickst, sind List und Gewandtheit deine einzigen Verbündeten. Sprich mit den Bewohnern von Burg Dieruin, mache deine Feinde zu Freunden, und drehe auf deiner Mission, Merra zu finden, jeden Stein um.
 

 
Wenn du weitere Infos zu Ghost of a Tale suchst oder dich in unseren Foren über das Spiel austauschen möchtest, dann schau doch mal hier vorbei: http://www.ghostofatale.com/

Jeremiah Pena ist der Komponist des Spiels, und das Sounddesign stammt aus der Feder von Nicolas Titeux. Jerome Jacinto bringt seine Expertise als Zeichner von 2D-Grafiken im Spiel ein.

Ghost of a Tale segue le gesta di un coraggioso Topo menestrello di nome Tilo nella pericolosa missione di sfuggire alle segrete di Forte Derovin e scoprire il destino del suo vero amore, Marna. Ambientato in un mondo medievale in cui i Ratti dominano tutte le altre creature, Ghost of a Tale intreccia una storia epica e profonda al tempo stesso, combinando elementi dei classici giochi di avventura, RPG d'azione e di esplorazione con uno stile visivo ricco e altamente coinvolgente.
 

 
Nei panni di un topo armato con il talento per la furtività, l'agilità e il travestimento e il dono di un menestrello per la musica, esplorerai la sempre più decrepita fortezza, dai suoi vasti boschi alle rive dei laghi, fino ad arrivare alle sue catacombe infestate da ragni, sfuggendo ai suoi numerosi pericoli e scoprendo i suoi più antichi segreti. 
 

 
Forte Derovin è un posto pericoloso per un piccolo Topo, e Tilo non si può certo definire un guerriero. Quando ti troverai ad affrontare nemici mortali del doppio della tua taglia, la tua astuzia e agilità saranno le tue uniche alleate. Parla con gli abitanti di Forte Derovin, trasforma i tuoi nemici in alleati, e cerca in ogni dove nella tua missione alla ricerca di Marna.
 

 
Per ulteriori informazioni su Ghost of a Tale, o per discutere del gioco sui nostri forum, visita il sito: http://www.ghostofatale.com/
 

 
La squadra:
 
Ghost of a Tale è stato sviluppato da una squadra di pochi (ma buoni!) membri. Lionel "Seith" Gallat è il suo creatore, responsabile del 90% della grafica, progettazione e programmazione del gioco. Paul Gardner è l’autore del gioco, nonché esperto progettista di giochi. Cyrille Paulhiac si occupa di programmazione e dello sviluppo di strumenti. Jeremiah Pena è il compositore del gioco, mentre Nicolas Titeux è il progettista del sono. Jerome Jacinto ha contribuito alla grafica 2D del gioco con la sua esperienza di illustratore.

Ghost of a Tale is an action-RPG game in which you play as Tilo, a mouse and minstrel thrown into a perilous adventure. Through stealth and cunning you’ll be able to explore the secrets of Dwindling Heights Keep and navigate its dangers.

Ghost of a Tale takes place in a medieval world inhabited by several species of anthropomorphic animals, many of which inhabit their own kingdom: the lore includes mice, rats, frogs, crabs, badgers, hawks, spiders, leeches, magpies and various undead creatures.

The game is set centuries after a cataclysmic event known as the War of the Green Flame. During this time, a mysterious ball of emerald fire of unknown origin swept across the world, killing all who stood against it and raising their bodies into an ever-growing undead army. At the height of the conflict, the mouse kingdom sent an envoy to the flame attempting to save their home by revealing the weaknesses of others, but the being could not be reasoned with and destroyed most of their land regardless.

In the end, it was the rat army who rose up to finally defeat the entity, becoming the heroes of the war, and expelled the mice from the land's governing body forever for their treachery. Hundreds of years later, the exact history of these events has become clouded in time, with the only true account being held in the oral traditions of a group of magpies called the Truth Sayers, who live in a tower on an ancient island.

At the beginning of the game, Tilo mouse is thrown into a dungeon by rats: he must escape from his prison and the surrounding lands. The many adversaries Tilo faces are much stronger than him: the courageous little mouse will need to be smart, stealthy and agile to succeed!

title: Chants of Sennaar
description:
Winner of Best Indie Game at the 2024 New York Game Awards and nominated multiple times at other ceremonies including The Game Awards and the BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar is a critically-acclaimed puzzle and adventure game developed by Rundisc.
 
 Divided since the dawn of time, the Peoples of the Tower no longer speak to each other, isolated by fear or mistrust. It is said that one day, a Traveler will find the wisdom to break down the walls and restore the balance. Travel the endless steps of a prodigious labyrinth, uncover the truth and unveil the mysteries of this fascinating universe where ancient languages are both the lock and the key.

 Inspired by the myth of Babel, discover an enigmatic and vast tower. As the Traveler, delve into a world full of mysteries, where Peoples have grown distant, unable to communicate with each other anymore. Begin your adventure in a prodigious tower inhabited by five distinct Peoples, observe, listen, and strive to mend the bonds of distrust. 
  
 With a smart gameplay system, explore and solve various puzzles to uncover the mysteries of five different interconnected languages. Always guided by your trusty notebook, note each symbol, keep track of your surroundings, engage in conversations with people and unravel the meaning of every glyph. Each step will pave your way to the top of the Tower as each word will restore the link between People.
  
 Dive into an enthralling and colorful world full of secrets. Tumble headlong into a beautiful world inspired by impactful European comics authors where every floor of the Tower possesses its own visual identity, supported by distinctive technological levels, architecture and culture. Embark on a poetic and enchanting journey driven by a soul-stirring, lyrical soundtrack, made by Thomas Brunet.

Chants of Sennaar es un juego de aventuras y puzles desarrollado por Rundisc y distribuido por Focus Entertainment. Ha recibido grandes elogios por parte de la crítica y el premio al Mejor Juego Independiente en los New York Game Awards 2024, además de diversas nominaciones a otros premios como los BAFTA y The Game Awards.
 
 Divididos desde el albor de los tiempos, aislados por miedo o desconfianza, los pueblos de la torre ya no se hablan. Mas cuenta la leyenda que un viajero sabrá derribar los muros y recuperar el equilibrio. Recorre los infinitos caminos de un laberinto prodigioso, averigua la verdad y desvela los misterios de este universo fascinante en el que antiguos idiomas son tanto puerta como llave.

 Descubre una enorme y enigmática torre inspirada en el mito de Babel. Encarna al viajero y sumérgete en un mundo lleno de misterios donde las gentes se han distanciado y ya no son capaces de comunicarse entre ellas. Empieza la aventura en una torre prodigiosa habitada por cinco pueblos diferentes, observa, escucha e intenta rehacer los vínculos que ha roto la desconfianza.

 Disfruta de un ingenioso sistema de juego, explora y resuelve puzles para revelar los secretos de cinco idiomas distintos pero relacionados. Con la ayuda de tu fiel cuaderno, toma nota de cada símbolo, lleva un registro del entorno, habla con la gente y desentraña el significado de los glifos. Cada paso será un peldaño en el ascenso a la torre y cada palabra un eslabón en los vínculos entre las gentes.

 Sumérgete en un lugar colorido y cautivador lleno de secretos. Lánzate a un mundo hermoso inspirado por prestigiosos autores de cómic europeos en el que cada nivel de la torre cuenta con una identidad visual propia y una tecnología, arquitectura y cultura características. Emprende un viaje apasionante y poético con una banda sonora lírica y conmovedora compuesta por Thomas Brunet.

Nommé meilleur jeu indépendant aux New York Game Awards 2024 et nominé à de nombreuses reprises lors d'autres événements (notamment The Game Awards et les BAFTA), Chants of Sennaar est un jeu d'aventure à énigmes salué par la critique. Il est développé par Rundisc.
 
 Divisés depuis la nuit des temps, isolés par la peur ou la méfiance, les Peuples de la Tour ne se parlent plus. On dit qu'un jour, un voyageur d'une grande sagesse brisera ces murs de défiance et rétablira l'équilibre. Grimpez les escaliers interminables d'un extraordinaire labyrinthe, découvrez la vérité et levez le voile sur les mystères de cet univers fascinant où les langues anciennes constituent à la fois des obstacles et des solutions. 

 Découvrez une tour aussi imposante qu'énigmatique dans ce jeu qui s'inspire du mythe de la Tour de Babel. Dans le rôle du Voyageur, plongez dans un monde de mystères où les peuples se sont éloignés les uns avec les autres, au point de ne plus pouvoir communiquer entre eux. Commencez l'aventure dans cette tour prodigieuse habitée par cinq peuplades très différentes. Observez, écoutez et faites tout votre possible pour rétablir la confiance d'autrefois.

 Avec son gameplay astucieux, le jeu vous permettra d'explorer les lieux et de résoudre diverses énigmes pour élucider les mystères de cinq langues à la fois distinctes et liées les unes aux autres. Prenez des notes sur les symboles et l'environnement dans votre fidèle carnet, engagez la conversation avec différentes personnes et découvrez la signification de tous les glyphes. À chaque pas qui vous rapprochera du sommet de la tour, les mots vous permettront de rétablir les liens entre les peuples.

 Plongez-vous dans un monde haut en couleur regorgeant de secrets. Explorez des environnements sublimes qui s'inspirent de bandes dessinées européennes, chaque étage de la tour ayant une identité visuelle, un niveau technologique, une architecture et une culture qui lui sont propres. Embarquez-vous dans un voyage poétique et enchanteur au son d'une bande originale lyrique et émouvante composée par Thomas Brunet.

Das bei den New York Game Awards 2024 als bestes Indie-Spiel ausgezeichnete und bei anderen Preisverleihungen wie The Game Awards und BAFTA mehrfach nominierte Chants of Sennaar ist ein von der Kritik hochgelobtes Rätsel- und Abenteuerspiel, das von Rundisc entwickelt wurde.
 
 Die seit Anbeginn der Zeit durch Angst und Misstrauen voneinander isolierten Völker des Turms kommunizieren nicht mehr miteinander. Es heißt, dass eines Tages ein Reisender die Weisheit finden wird, die Mauern niederzureißen und das Gleichgewicht wiederherzustellen. Erklimme die endlosen Stufen eines gewaltigen Labyrinths, entdecke die Wahrheit und lüfte die Geheimnisse dieses faszinierenden Universums, in dem die uralten Sprachen Schlüssel und Schloss zugleich sind.

 Erkunde einen gewaltigen vom Mythos von Babel inspirierten Turm voller Rätsel. Als Reisender tauchst du in eine geheimnisvolle Welt ein, in der sich die Völker immer weiter voneinander entfernt haben und nicht mehr in der Lage sind, sich zu verständigen. Beginne dein Abenteuer in einem riesigen Turm, der von fünf verschiedenen Völkern bewohnt wird. Beobachte, lausche und versuche, die vom Misstrauen zerrissenen Bande wiederherzustellen.

 Erkunde den Turm und löse unterschiedliche Rätsel mithilfe eines intelligenten Spielsystems, um die Geheimnisse fünf miteinander verbundener Sprachen zu lüften. Dein treuer Begleiter ist dabei das Notizbuch, in dem du jedes gefundene Symbol notierst. Behalte deine Umgebung im Auge, unterhalte dich mit den Bewohnern und entziffere die Bedeutung aller Glyphen. Mit jedem entschlüsselten Wort stellst du die Verbindung zwischen den Völkern wieder her und kommst der Spitze des Turms ein Stück näher.

 Eine mitreißende, farbenfrohe Welt voller Geheimnisse und Rätsel erwartet dich. Stürze dich kopfüber in eine wunderschöne Spielumgebung, die sich an einflussreichen europäischen Comics orientiert. Jede Ebene des Turms besitzt ihre eigene visuelle Identität, die sich in Form einzigartiger Technologien, Architektur und Kultur äußert. Begib dich auf ein zauberhaftes Abenteuer, das mit einem gefühlvollen lyrischen Soundtrack von Thomas Brunet unterlegt ist.

Vincitore del premio Best Indie Game ai New York Game Awards del 2024 e plurinominato in altre premiazioni tra cui The Game Awards e i BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar è un gioco di avventura e rompicapi acclamato dalla critica, sviluppato da Rundisc.
 
 Separati fin dall'alba del tempo, i Popoli della Torre non comunicano più gli uni con gli altri, isolati dalla paura o dalla sfiducia. Si dice che un giorno verrà un Viaggiatore, e la sua saggezza abbatterà le barriere e ristabilirà l'equilibrio. Viaggia per le scalinate interminabili di un prodigioso labirinto, scopri la verità e svela i misteri di questo universo affascinante in cui le lingue antiche sono insieme chiave e serratura. 

 Scopri una torre enigmatica e vasta, ispirata al mito di Babele. Nei panni del Viaggiatore, esplora un mondo pieno di misteri, dove i Popoli si sono allontanati, ormai incapaci di comunicare tra loro. Inizia la tua avventura in una torre prodigiosa abitata da cinque diversi Popoli: osserva, ascolta e fai ogni sforzo per rinsaldare i legami spezzati dalla sfiducia.

 Grazie al sistema di gameplay intelligente, esplora e risolvi diversi enigmi per scoprire i misteri di cinque diverse lingue interconnesse tra loro. Sotto la guida costante del tuo fedele diario, annota ogni simbolo, tieni traccia dell'ambiente circostante, conversa con le persone e svela il significato di ciascun glifo. Ogni passo in avanti ti porterà verso la vetta della Torre, e ogni parola rinsalderà i legami tra i Popoli.

 Immergiti in un mondo appassionante e pittoresco, colmo di segreti. Tuffati in un mondo magnifico ispirato ai maestri del fumetto europeo dove ciascun piano della Torre ha una sua identità visiva, con tecnologie, architetture e culture ben distinte. Parti per un viaggio poetico e ammaliante accompagnato da una colonna sonora che risuona in fondo all'anima, realizzata da Thomas Brunet.

Winner of Best Indie Game at the 2024 New York Game Awards and nominated multiple times at other ceremonies including The Game Awards and the BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar is a critically-acclaimed puzzle and adventure game developed by Rundisc.
 
 Divided since the dawn of time, the Peoples of the Tower no longer speak to each other, isolated by fear or mistrust. It is said that one day, a Traveler will find the wisdom to break down the walls and restore the balance. Travel the endless steps of a prodigious labyrinth, uncover the truth and unveil the mysteries of this fascinating universe where ancient languages are both the lock and the key.

 Inspired by the myth of Babel, discover an enigmatic and vast tower. As the Traveler, delve into a world full of mysteries, where Peoples have grown distant, unable to communicate with each other anymore. Begin your adventure in a prodigious tower inhabited by five distinct Peoples, observe, listen, and strive to mend the bonds of distrust. 
  
 With a smart gameplay system, explore and solve various puzzles to uncover the mysteries of five different interconnected languages. Always guided by your trusty notebook, note each symbol, keep track of your surroundings, engage in conversations with people and unravel the meaning of every glyph. Each step will pave your way to the top of the Tower as each word will restore the link between People.
  
 Dive into an enthralling and colorful world full of secrets. Tumble headlong into a beautiful world inspired by impactful European comics authors where every floor of the Tower possesses its own visual identity, supported by distinctive technological levels, architecture and culture. Embark on a poetic and enchanting journey driven by a soul-stirring, lyrical soundtrack, made by Thomas Brunet.

title: Hades
description:
A rogue-lite hack and slash dungeon crawler in which Zagreus, son of Hades the Greek god of the dead, attempts to escape his home and his oppressive father by fighting the souls of the dead through the various layers of the ever-shifting underworld, while getting to know and forging relationships with its inhabitants.

Zagreus, the son of Hades, has discovered that his mother, which he was led to believe was Nyx, Night Incarnate, is actually someone else, and is outside Hell. He is now attempting to escape his father's domain, with the help of the other gods of Olympus, in an attempt to find his real mother.

localized_description.text:
A rogue-lite hack and slash dungeon crawler in which Zagreus, son of Hades the Greek god of the dead, attempts to escape his home and his oppressive father by fighting the souls of the dead through the various layers of the ever-shifting underworld, while getting to know and forging relationships with its inhabitants.

Zagreus, the son of Hades, has discovered that his mother, which he was led to believe was Nyx, Night Incarnate, is actually someone else, and is outside Hell. He is now attempting to escape his father's domain, with the help of the other gods of Olympus, in an attempt to find his real mother.

Hades 是一款高自由度砍杀型地下城游戏，融合了 Supergiant 众多经典作品的传统特色，其中包括战斗节奏较快的《Bastion》、游戏环境丰富多彩，细节深入的《Transistor》以及随着游戏人物推进，故事情节跌宕起伏的《Pyre》。

【杀出地狱】
作为不朽的冥界王子，你将挥舞着来自奥林匹斯山充满神力的各种武器，在险恶的旅途中挣脱死神的魔爪，变得愈发强大，每次逃离行动都将开启更多精彩的故事。
释放来自奥林匹斯山的怒火
奥林匹斯众神将为你提供庇佑！在和宙斯、雅典娜、波塞冬和更多大神的奇遇中，获得数十种强大恩赐，让你的战斗力直线飙升。踏上逃离黑暗地狱的征程，各色游戏人物陪你一路降妖伏魔。

【结交神鬼妖怪各路朋友】
一众性格鲜明的传奇人物都在期待你的登场！加深和他们的关系，并体验数百个奇特冒险故事，逐渐了解这个宗系庞杂的神族中不为人知的各种骇人秘闻。

【惊险刺激，百玩不厌】
每次深入到变化多端的冥界，你都会获得新的惊喜，冥界的终极守护者会对你“颇为记挂”。利用强大的夜之圣镜，永久加强自己的能力，下次可以更轻松地逃离冥界苦海。

【挑战无限可能】
永久升级意味着你不必成为神，就可以体验激动人心的战斗和扣人心弦的故事。不过，如果你自认堪比神抵，那就可以加大挑战难度，体验更加惊险刺激的行动，看看身经百战的你是否经得住这次的考验。

【经典的 SUPERGIANT 风格】
Supergiant 各类游戏内容丰富、大气磅礴以及游戏和故事叙述相结合的特有风格，在这款游戏中表现得淋漓尽致：壮观的手绘冥界环境和令人胆寒的原创配乐，营造冥界阴森恐怖的氛围，让人身临其境。

【加入玩家社群】
Hades 从一开始就打算围绕 Early Access 来开发。在这里进行讨论，或者加入 Supergiant 的官方Discord服务器，告诉我们的团队您对本游戏的看法。我们会查阅每位玩家的反馈，这些反馈对每次的重大更新都有很大参加价值。

ALSO FROM SUPERGIANT GAMES  The god-like rogue-like returns!
 
 
  About the Game       
  Hades  is a  god-like  rogue-like dungeon crawler that combines the best aspects of Supergiant's critically acclaimed titles, including the fast-paced action of  Bastion , the rich atmosphere and depth of  Transistor , and the character-driven storytelling of  Pyre . BATTLE OUT OF HELL As the immortal Prince of the Underworld, you'll wield the powers and mythic weapons of Olympus to break free from the clutches of the god of the dead himself, while growing stronger and unraveling more of the story with each unique escape attempt. UNLEASH THE FURY OF OLYMPUS The Olympians have your back! Meet Zeus, Athena, Poseidon, and many more, and choose from their dozens of powerful Boons that enhance your abilities. There are thousands of viable character builds to discover as you go.
 
 
        BEFRIEND GODS, GHOSTS, AND MONSTERS A fully-voiced cast of colorful, larger-than-life characters is waiting to meet you! Grow your relationships with them, and experience thousands of unique story events as you learn about what's really at stake for this big, dysfunctional family. BUILT FOR REPLAYABILITY New surprises await each time you delve into the ever-shifting Underworld, whose guardian bosses will remember you. Use the powerful Mirror of Night to grow permanently stronger, and give yourself a leg up the next time you run away from home. NOTHING IS IMPOSSIBLE Permanent upgrades mean you don't have to be a god yourself to experience the exciting combat and gripping story. Though, if you happen to be one, crank up the challenge and get ready for some white-knuckle action that will put your well-practiced skills to the test.
 
 
     SIGNATURE SUPERGIANT STYLE The rich, atmospheric presentation and unique melding of gameplay and narrative that's been core to Supergiant's games is here in full force: spectacular hand-painted environments and a blood-pumping original score bring the Underworld to life.

ALSO FROM SUPERGIANT GAMES  The god-like rogue-like returns!
 
 
  Acerca del juego       
  Hades  es un juego  roguelike  de exploración de mazmorras que combina los mejores aspectos de los aclamados títulos anteriores de Supergiant, como la acción rápida de  Bastion , la atmósfera y la profundidad de  Transistor  y la narrativa centrada en los personajes de  Pyre . COMBATE PARA ESCAPAR DEL INFIERNO Como el príncipe inmortal del Inframundo, tendrás a tu disposición los poderes y las armas míticas del Olimpo para liberarte de las garras del mismísimo dios de los muertos, al tiempo que te vas haciendo más fuerte y descubres más piezas de la historia con cada intento de fuga. DESATA LA IRA DEL OLIMPO ¡Los dioses del Olimpo están de tu lado! Conoce a Zeus, Atenea, Poseidón y muchos más, y elige entre decenas de poderosas bendiciones que potenciarán tus habilidades. Hay miles de arquetipos de personaje viables que irás descubriendo a medida que juegues.
 
 
        ALÍATE CON DIOSES, FANTASMAS Y MONSTRUOS Disfruta con las voces de un elenco de personajes verdaderamente carismáticos y deseosos de conocerte. Desarrolla tus relaciones con ellos y experimenta cientos de eventos de historia únicos, a medida que vas descubriendo los secretos de esta enorme y disfuncional familia. DISEÑADO PARA SER REJUGABLE Te esperan nuevas sorpresas cada vez que te adentres en el siempre cambiante Inframundo, cuyos jefes guardianes te recordarán entre partida y partida. Usa el poderoso Espejo de la Noche para adquirir mejoras permanentes y aguantar un poco más la próxima vez que intentes huir. NO HAY NADA IMPOSIBLE Gracias a las mejoras permanentes, no hace falta ser un dios para experimentar la emoción de los combates y la fascinante historia. Pero si lo eres, aumenta el nivel de desafío y prepárate para una dosis de acción salvaje que pondrá a prueba tus habilidades hasta límites insospechados.
 
 
     EL ESTILO CARACTERÍSTICO DE SUPERGIANT La cuidada presentación atmosférica y la fusión única de jugabilidad y narrativa que han formado parte de todos los juegos de Supergiant se desarrolla aquí en su máximo esplendor: los impresionantes entornos dibujados a mano y la intensa banda sonora original consiguen que el Inframundo cobre vida de forma espectacular.

ALSO FROM SUPERGIANT GAMES  The god-like rogue-like returns!
 
 
  À propos du jeu       
  Hades  est un rogue-like en mode dungeon crawler qui associe le meilleur des titres de Supergiant salués par la critique. Il combine l'action effrénée de  Bastion , la profondeur et l'atmosphère très riche de  Transistor , ainsi que la narration centrée sur les personnages qui caractérise  Pyre . LUTTEZ POUR ÉCHAPPER AUX ENFERS Dans la peau de l'immortel prince des Enfers, vous manierez les pouvoirs et les armes mythiques de l'Olympe pour vous libérer des griffes du dieu des morts en personne, développant vos forces et dévoilant de nouveaux secrets à chaque nouvelle tentative d'évasion. DÉCHAÎNEZ LA FUREUR DE L'OLYMPE Les dieux de l'Olympe sont à vos côtés ! Rencontrez Zeus, Athéna, Poséidon et bien d'autres encore, et faites votre choix parmi les dizaines de puissants Bienfaits qu'ils vous offrent pour décupler vos facultés. Découvrez au cours de votre progression des milliers de configurations personnage réalisables.
 
 
        DIEUX, FANTÔMES ET MONSTRES SONT DE VOS AMIS Toute une bande de personnages hauts en couleur et hors du commun vous attend ! Faites évoluer vos relations et découvrez des centaines d'événements narratifs uniques en perçant à jour les motivations cachées de cette famille aussi grande que peu ordinaire. CONÇU POUR ÊTRE REJOUABLE De nouvelles surprises vous attendent à chacune de vos descentes dans l'univers changeant des Enfers, et jamais les boss qui en sont les gardiens ne vous oublieront. Utilisez le puissant Miroir de la nuit pour devenir plus fort de manière définitive et gagner un avantage lors de votre prochaine échappée. RIEN N'EST IMPOSSIBLE Grâce aux améliorations permanentes, pas besoin d'être un dieu pour vivre les combats électrisants et l'histoire palpitante de cette aventure. Mais si vous en êtes un, relevez des défis toujours plus ardus et préparez-vous à de l'action dont l'intensité mettra vos compétences aiguisées à l'épreuve.
 
 
     LE STYLE CARACTÉRISTIQUE DE SUPERGIANT L'atmosphère riche et onirique et la fusion gameplay/narration si particulière aux jeux Supergiant prennent ici toute leur ampleur : de spectaculaires décors peints à la main et une bande-son originale exaltante donnent vie aux Enfers.

ALSO FROM SUPERGIANT GAMES  The god-like rogue-like returns!
 
 
  Infos zum Spiel       
  Hades  ist ein Rogue-like Dungeon Crawler, der das Beste aus Supergiants preisgekrönten Spielen vereint: die temporeiche Action von  Bastion , die dichte Atmosphäre von  Transistor  und eine fesselnde Handlung, bei der wie in  Pyre  die Charaktere im Mittelpunkt stehen. KÄMPF DICH AUS DER HÖLLE Als unsterblicher Prinz der Unterwelt nutzt du die Kräfte und mythischen Waffen des Olymp, um dich aus den Fängen des Totengotts höchstpersönlich zu befreien. Jeder Fluchtversuch ist einzigartig, macht dich stärker und enthüllt neue Geheimnisse. ENTFESSLE DEN ZORN DES OLYMP Die Götter des Olymp stehen dir zur Seite! Wähle zwischen Zeus, Athene, Poseidon und vielen weiteren Göttern, deren Gaben dir ungeahnte Fähigkeiten verleihen. Das Spiel bietet Tausende Möglichkeiten, deinen Charakter nach und nach individuell zu gestalten.
 
 
        GESTATTEN: GÖTTER, GEISTER UND MONSTER Eine Welt voller lebendiger, unverwechselbarer Persönlichkeiten erwartet dich! Schließe Freundschaften, um Hunderte einzigartige Ereignisse zu erleben, und finde heraus, welche Leichen deine große, zerrüttete Familie wirklich im Keller hat. HOHER WIEDERSPIELWERT Jeder Ausflug in diese dynamische Unterwelt birgt neue Überraschungen, und ihre Wächter behalten dich im Gedächtnis. Mit dem mächtigen Spiegel der Nacht wirst du stärker und stärker und erhältst einen entscheidenden Vorsprung, wenn du das nächste Mal von deinem höllischen Zuhause wegläufst. ALLES IST MÖGLICH Dank laufender Upgrades musst du kein Gott sein, um spannende Kämpfe und eine fesselnde Story zu erleben. Aber wenn du zufällig einer bist, dann stell dich der Herausforderung und mach dich bereit für rasante Action, bei der du all dein Geschick benötigen wirst.
 
 
     DER UNVERWECHSELBARE STIL VON SUPERGIANT Detailverliebte, atmosphärische Spielwelten und eine innovative Verknüpfung von Gameplay und Handlung – das zeichnet die Spiele von Supergiant aus. Spektakuläre, handgemalte Umgebungen und ein mitreißender Soundtrack lassen Hades’ Unterwelt lebendig werden.
